title: Sort List
description:
Given the head of a linked list, return the list after sorting it in ascending order . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/09/14/sort_list_1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [4,2,1,3]

Output:
 [1,2,3,4]
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/09/14/sort_list_2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [-1,5,3,4,0]

Output:
 [-1,0,3,4,5]
```

 Example 3: 
 
```
Input:
 head = []

Output:
 []
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 5 * 10 4 ] . 
 
 -10 5 <= Node.val <= 10 5 

 Follow up: Can you sort the linked list in O(n logn) time and O(1) memory (i.e. constant space)?
